title: Briouat Turnip Fritters
description: A French-inspired twist on traditional Moroccan briouats, these fritters are crispy on the outside and tender on the inside with a delicious turnip and cheese filling.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated turnip, chopped almonds, grated Gruyère, ground cumin, and 1/2 cup all-purpose gluten-free flour.
Add a pinch of salt to taste.
In a separate bowl, whisk together 1 egg and a splash of water.
Add the egg mixture to the turnip mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Shape each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, add a few of the turnip disks to the skillet (do not overcrowd).
Fry the briouat fritters for about 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve hot.
